name: Pace Target Program
description: A 4-week progressive running program building pace through endurance, intervals, tempo, HIIT, and progression runs. 3 sessions per week on a 7-day cycle.

workouts.notes: Zone 2 conversational pace. Keep effort easy — you should be able to hold a full conversation.
10 min warmup, then 6×2 min at 5K pace with 1 min easy jog recovery, 4 min cooldown.
Zone 2 easy aerobic run. Build your aerobic base — time on feet matters more than speed.
10 min warmup, then 6×2 min at 5K pace with 1 min easy jog recovery, 4 min cooldown.
10 min warmup, 15 min at threshold pace (comfortably hard, ~7/10 effort), 5 min cooldown.
Zone 2 easy aerobic run. Build your aerobic base — time on feet matters more than speed.
10 min warmup, then 8×1 min hard (near max effort) with 1 min easy jog recovery, 4 min cooldown.
10 min warmup, then 6×2 min at 5K pace with 1 min easy jog recovery, 4 min cooldown.
Long run at Zone 2 conversational pace. The goal is time on feet, not speed.
Start at easy Zone 2 pace and increase speed every 10 minutes: 10 min easy, 10 min moderate, 10 min threshold.
10 min warmup, then 6×2 min at 5K pace with 1 min easy jog recovery, 4 min cooldown.
Zone 2 easy aerobic run. Build your aerobic base — time on feet matters more than speed.
